أقترض (form VIII)
# أَقْتَرِضُ (ʔaqtariḍu) /ʔaq.ta.ri.dˤu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
# أُقْتَرَضُ (ʔuqtaraḍu) /ʔuq.ta.ra.dˤu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
# أَقْتَرِضَ (ʔaqtariḍa) /ʔaq.ta.ri.dˤa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
# أُقْتَرَضَ (ʔuqtaraḍa) /ʔuq.ta
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
